title: Night Shift
format: state-console v0 (slice): see story/night-shift-slice-notes.md. Text only, no media.
slice: handover to the first log-wording decision, 18:45 to 22:05

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: the log's voice: plain, present tense, second person

scenes.text: Control room, behind the lobby desk. Mr. Okafor has the day's log open on the tablet. By the radio charger, a woman is counting under her breath.

wall.C1: lobby, day crowd thinning, desk lit
wall.C3: dock, rollup door down, one hand truck
wall.C7: 58 reception, low light, glass doors shut

lines.text: So. Let's walk through the log. I have a train.
lines.dir: polite, one arm already in his coat

lines.text: Visitor on nineteen, a Mr. Pruitt. Out at 1640. Elevator contractor is back Thursday.
Forty-four. Water in the closet. Monitored.
Four.
lines.dir: to the charger, not turning around

lines.text: Dolores. You can say hello.
Hello. Sit anywhere that isn't mine.
Mm.
lines.dir: a sound at the charger, no more

lines.text: Dolores signs your hours. The binder's on the shelf, next to the…
Extinguisher. Mm-hm. Your train, Okafor.
lines.dir: not unkind, she has heard this speech before

scenes.log: 1845 hrs. Handover from Mr. Okafor, day supervisor, to night post. D. Reyes assigned as trainer.

scenes.text: Mr. Okafor turns the tablet toward you. A box for your initials sits under the last line of the day.

wall.C1: lobby, two people at the turnstiles

lines.text: Initial here. That says you've seen the day's log.
lines.dir: tablet held out, a little too long

lines.text: Forty-four is the third line. Water was dry by four.
lines.dir: answering a question he was glad to get

lines.text: Thursday. Ten a.m. Not your shift.
There's a note on page two. A guy in the vestibule Tuesday. Individual.
Read it.
lines.dir: from the charger; one word, not a suggestion

lines.text: It's two pages.
Then it's two minutes.
Initial.

scenes.text: Mr. Okafor takes his bag and goes. The door to the lobby swings shut behind him. Dolores puts the fourth radio on the charger and knocks twice on the wall.

lines.text: It's customary to read it first.
lines.dir: from the door, tired, not angry

lines.text: Mm.
Four radios. Four on the charger when I walk in. Four when I leave.
Doesn't matter why.
Coffee's on the left. It's wrong. Don't tell me it's wrong.
lines.dir: tapping the machine with one finger

lines.text: Officer. You've got a name? Say it once. I'll use it when I use it.
lines.dir: looking at you for the first time

scenes.log: 1858 hrs. Day supervisor off post. Radios 4 of 4 on charger.

scenes.text: Two chairs face the wall. One has a good back. The other has a cushion flattened to the shape of one person.

lines.text: Sit.
lines.dir: already seated in the flat one

lines.text: Knocking on it again, are we.
lines.dir: to the wall, not to you

lines.text: No, not… That one's the good one. Take it.
lines.dir: a half-gesture, then back to the wall

lines.text: You're in my chair, Officer. Go on, I'll live.
The clock's two minutes fast. Leave it.
Radios. You've got one. Clip it on.

scenes.text: The radio on the desk crackles. It is Terrell, out front. The charger light is green. Dolores doesn't move.

wall.C1: lobby, Terrell at the desk, lifting a hand to the lens

lines.text: Control to post one, radio check. Post one? Hey. Radio check, you know?
That's you.
Button's on the side. Side. The…
lines.dir: cut off by her own sigh

lines.text: Mm. A minute late.
Mm.
lines.dir: the small one, the good one

choices.text: Hold the radio out to Dee

scenes.text: Terrell leans in from the lobby for coffee he says he won't drink. Dolores unwraps something from foil and doesn't open it all the way.

wall.C1: lobby, desk empty for a moment

lines.text: So where'd they get you from? Wait. Let me guess. Queens. You've got a Queens, you know?
Terrell. Desk.
I'm going, I'm going. Hey, you see the game? Two points. Two. In the last…
lines.dir: backing out the door, still talking

lines.text: Where do you live?
lines.dir: to you, a real question, which surprises her

lines.text: The seven? Mm. It stops. It always stops, right under Queensboro.
Pepper and egg. Half past midnight. Don't ask for a bite.
Ray used to… Forget it. Drink the coffee.
lines.dir: trails off, picks up the cup instead

lines.text: Back's all right? It's the only thing in here that is.
lines.dir: a dry look at the chair

lines.text: It's wrong. I said not to say.

scenes.text: Two monitors, nine tiles. Dolores puts a pencil against the glass without touching it. The first row is the lobby, the vestibule, the dock.

wall.C2: vestibule, glass fogged at the corners

lines.text: One. Lobby. Two. Vestibule. Three, dock.
lines.dir: pencil moving left to right, no hurry

lines.text: Say what you see. Not what it is.
Good. Next.
lines.dir: approving the way a stamp does

lines.text: Nothing's normal. Same lobby all night. That's normal.
lines.dir: a small shrug in the voice

lines.text: Dead. Mm. That's the idea.
Look at it till it's boring. Then look again.
lines.dir: tapping the glass of tile two with the pencil

lines.text: Mm-hm. Next.

scenes.text: The second row: a stairwell landing on thirty-one, the elevator lobby, a corridor on forty-four. Then the chairman's glass doors. The roof. A cabinet on two.

wall.C5: elevator lobby 31, a plant, four cars
wall.C6: floor 44 corridor, closet door, dark floor at the sill
wall.C9: cabinet and fire panel repeater, floor 2, steady

lines.text: Four. Five. Six.
Seven's the fifty-eighth. It's always lit. Don't ask me why.
lines.dir: a pause long enough to be a comment

lines.text: Nine's the quiet one. Floor two. Cabinet, the panel's repeater.
lines.dir: the pencil stops on the last tile

lines.text: Nine never moves. If it moves, say.
Roof door. Eight. I do that one at three. Alone.
lines.dir: too quickly, then back to the wall

lines.text: That's the wall. You've seen it. Now you've seen it.

scenes.log: 1935 hrs. Wall: nine feeds on two monitors, all normal.

scenes.text: You walked the stairwells, the dock, the roof door. Back at the lobby desk, Dolores lays out the visitor sheet and puts a pen and a pencil beside it.
scenes.ambience: lobby, marble, a revolving door turning once

wall.C1: lobby, Dolores and you at the desk
wall.C6: floor 44 corridor, cart parked, light under the closet door

lines.text: Name. Company. Who they're seeing. Floor. In. Out.
ID, you look at it. Look. Not glance.
After hours, the tenant says yes first. Email, call-up. No yes, no entry.
lines.dir: like a recipe she has said a thousand times

lines.text: However nice.
Pen's for the sheet. Pencil's for… Pick one.
Once it's ink, it's true. I write it in pencil first.
lines.dir: gives it up like a coin

lines.text: Mm. Good.

scenes.log: 2010 hrs. Tour: stairwells A, B, C, dock, roof door. No incident. Visitor sheet reviewed with D. Reyes.

scenes.text: The walkie on the desk goes off, loud. On the corridor tile for forty-four, a woman stands at a door with a younger man holding a mop bucket.
scenes.ambience: control-room-hum, walkie static, a vacuum far off

wall.C6: floor 44 corridor, Marisol and a young man at the badge reader, closet door behind

lines.text: Ay, mi amor, the badge, it doesn't open. It's new. He's new. He's with me.
And forty-four, the closet. Wet. *Wet.* You hear me?
Forty-four. You asked about forty-four.
lines.dir: to you, dry, a small nod

lines.text: Check the list.
Mm-hm. I know. I know what the book says.
lines.dir: cutting you off before the rule

lines.text: Tell your boss nothing. Tell him tomorrow. Okay?
lines.dir: walkie held too close to her mouth

lines.text: What's your call, Officer?
lines.dir: she doesn't look away from the wall

scenes.log: 2130 hrs. Floor 44. Badge reader reports failed read, new crew member of M. Quintero's crew. Water reported at closet door, 44.

scenes.text: You press the release. On tile six the reader goes green. The young man looks up at the lens, then goes in after the bucket.
scenes.ambience: door release buzz, bucket on tile

wall.C6: floor 44 corridor, young man inside, Marisol at the closet door

lines.text: Gracias, mi amor. Bendito. I owe you a plate.
lines.dir: already moving, the walkie bouncing on her hip

lines.text: Mm.
I'd have done it.
That's a line you write down, Officer.
lines.dir: flat, the pencil already in her hand

scenes.text: Mr. Okafor's night line rings four times. His voice is flatter on the phone, and there is a television somewhere behind it.
scenes.ambience: phone ringing, a television in another room

wall.C6: floor 44 corridor, Marisol and the young man still at the door, arms crossed

lines.text: So. Not on the list. Then he doesn't go in tonight.
lines.dir: phone-flat, a fork against a plate

lines.text: Put it in the log. Both times. When you called, when he said.
Hijo de… *Okay.* Okay. I don't forget this.
lines.dir: over the walkie, clipped, not warm

lines.text: She'll be fine by Thursday.
You called it. Fine. It's the book.
Mm-hm. I'd have… Doesn't matter.
lines.dir: trailing off, reaching for the cup

choices.text: Ask Dee to talk to her

scenes.text: Marisol holds a photocopy up to the lens. It is a name, a date, a stamp that doesn't read on tile six.

wall.C6: floor 44 corridor, Marisol holding a page to the lens, the young man behind her

lines.text: I told you! Look. Look at it. Paper. He has paper.
Read me the name.
That's a name. That's not the list.
lines.dir: turning the paper in her head

lines.text: Mm. But it's a name.
lines.dir: so low it's almost the wall talking

lines.text: So you let him wait in the hall. In the hall! Dios mío.

scenes.text: The tablet is open on the incident field for forty-four. Dolores puts the pencil down next to it. The cursor blinks.

wall.C6: floor 44 corridor, water at the closet door sill, a mop

lines.text: Say what you did.
I said I'd have done it. I didn't say write that I did.
lines.dir: answer to a question you already asked

lines.text: Water. Under the closet. You were watching.
Time. Place. What you saw. What you did. Who you told.
lines.dir: tapping the pencil on each word

lines.text: Nothing about how he looked.

effects.log: 2134 hrs. Floor 44. Crew member of M. Quintero's crew, not on after-hours list, badge failed. Admitted on M. Quintero's verbal word. Supervisor not notified.
2134 hrs. Floor 44. Quintero's nephew seemed harmless, probably fine. Let him in.
2134 hrs. Floor 44. Crew member badged in. No incident.

scenes.text: The tablet is open on the incident field for forty-four. Dolores puts the pencil down next to it. Marisol's walkie, far off on the floor, has gone quiet.

wall.C6: floor 44 corridor, the young man gone, the cart gone, water at the sill

lines.text: Say what you did.
I'd have done it differently. That doesn't go in.
Not 'she got mad.' When did she say it, and what did she say?
lines.dir: tapping the pencil on each word

lines.text: Time. Place. What you saw. Who you told.
Mm. Slow. You'll want to hurry. Don't.
lines.dir: while you reach for the tablet

effects.log: 2133 hrs. Floor 44. Crew member of M. Quintero's crew, not on after-hours list, badge failed. Entry refused. Supervisor night line called 2135, instructed same.
2133 hrs. Floor 44. Quintero was rude and upset, seemed to think the rules don't apply. Refused entry.
2133 hrs. Floor 44. Crew member admitted with supervisor's approval.

scenes.text: The tablet is open on the incident field for forty-four. A photocopy sits beside it, held down by the pencil. The young man waits in the corridor on tile six.

wall.C6: floor 44 corridor, the young man sitting on the bucket, Marisol with the closet door open

lines.text: Say what happened. The paper's evidence. It's not permission.
lines.dir: plain, flat on the second sentence

lines.text: You read the name. Good. That's the first line.
You handed it to me. It goes in your log, not mine.
lines.dir: pushing the pencil an inch toward you

lines.text: Time. Place. What was shown. What you did.
lines.dir: tapping the pencil on each word

effects.log: 2136 hrs. Floor 44. Crew member of M. Quintero's crew presented a photocopy of paperwork. Name not on after-hours list. Entry held pending list. Copy retained at desk.
2136 hrs. Floor 44. Paperwork looked legit, seemed to be in order. Probably fine.
2136 hrs. Floor 44. Crew member cleared by paperwork. No incident.

scenes.text: The line is saved. Dolores slides the pencil back across the desk. The radio on the charger is still green.

lines.text: Keep that one.
lines.dir: reading it twice, not out loud

lines.text: Facts only. What did you see?
lines.dir: reaching for the rubber on the end of the pencil

lines.text: Where's forty-four?
Mm.
lines.dir: the tablet slowly turned face down

lines.text: Officer.
Midnight. Don't forget the sandwich.
Two hours to the half. Eat something.

scenes.log: 2205 hrs. Wall: nine feeds, all normal. Incident 2134 entered.
